description: This file contains the base class for an RQL parser written in Scala, utilizing the akka-parboiled2 parsing library. It defines parsing rules for literals, numbers, strings, and whitespace, serving as a common foundation for parsing RQL expressions, predicates, and options.
external_methods: Rules for parsing literals, numbers, strings, whitespace, and other tokens
Methods for appending characters to the internal StringBuilder
Rules for handling escaped characters and Unicode sequences

classes.name: RqlParserBase
classes.description: A base parser class implementing common parsing rules for RQL expressions in Scala.

methods.name: Literal
methods.description: Parses literals including float, integer, string, boolean, or null values.

calls: Flexible method calls for parsing specific tokens and characters, e.g., anyOf, capture, zeroOrMore, rule, run, etc.
